answer: Every claim climbs the juniper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jetty re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
